blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Action-conditioned video world models predict future robot interactions from multiple cameras, yet their outputs remain disparate video collections rather than a shared metric scene queryable across viewpoints and time. While existing 4D reconstruction methods offer a path to spatialize these predictions, independently reconstructing and merging each camera stream fails to enforce cross-view consistency. This limitation is particularly detrimental when combining moving robot-mounted cameras with fixed external views. To address this, we introduce RoGSW4RLD, a feed-forward framework that lifts synchronized multi-camera rollouts into a unified, time-queryable metric 4D Gaussian field. Rather than learning a separate geometric transition model, RoGSW4RLD directly reconstructs the visual future generated by existing world models. Its core innovation is a two-stage architecture: Stage 1 jointly forms the metric 4D field by fusing cross-view evidence with robot-specific articulated geometry and kinematics, while Stage 2 refines the field’s geometry and appearance while strictly preserving the initial temporal displacements. Evaluated on 256 held-out DROID episodes, RoGSW4RLD significantly outperforms camera-wise reconstruction with calibrated merging, improving novel-view PSNR by 2.15 dB, reducing depth AbsRel by 47%, and lowering robot displacement error by 61%. These robust gains extend to action-conditioned Cosmos 3 rollouts, demonstrating that predicted video futures can be successfully translated into consistent, spatially queryable 4D metric representations.
blocks.zh: 以行动为条件的视频世界模型预测未来机器人从多个相机进行互动,然而其产出仍然是不同的视频收藏,而不是一个可跨观点和跨时间的共享度量场景。 虽然现有的4D重建方法为这些预测提供了空间化的路径,但独立重建和合并每个相机流都未能强制实现交叉视图的一致性. 在将移动的机器人挂载相机与固定的外部视图相结合时,这种限制特别不利. 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了RoGSW4RLD,一个向导框架,将同步多相机的推出提升到一个统一的,可时速测量的4D高斯场. RoGSW4RLD不是学习单独的几何过渡模型,而是直接重建现有世界模型产生的视觉未来. 其核心创新为两阶段架构:第一阶段通过将跨视证据与机器人特异性的清晰几何学和动能学相融合,共同形成度量4D领域,而第二阶段则在严格保留初始时间位移的同时完善了领域的几何学和外观. 评估了256个被搁置的DROID事件,RoGSW4RLD通过校准合并大大超过相机智能重建,将小说视角PSNR改进2.15 dB,深度AbsRel减少47%,将机器人移动错误降低61%. 这些扎实的成果扩展到行动条件Cosmos 3的推出,表明预测的视频未来可以成功转化为一致的,空间可查询的4D度度量表示.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Video world models predict how physical interactions evolve under future actions ( Ebert et al., 2018 ; Du et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024a ) . Spatial world models forecast geometric evolution ( Lu et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Zhen et al., 2025 ) , and related approaches construct dynamic Gaussian scenes from video generators ( Bahmani et al., 2026 ; Pan et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, multi-camera models like Cosmos 3 ( NVIDIA, 2026 ) output synchronized interaction videos but still lack a shared, temporally queryable metric scene. To address this, we lift these multi-view rollouts into a unified metric 4D Gaussian field (Figure 1 ). Rather than learning a new geometric transition model, our approach reconstructs the generated visual future directly.
blocks.zh: 视频世界模型预测未来行动下的物理相互作用如何演变(Ebert等人,2018年;Du等人,2023年;Yang等人,2024年a). 空间世界模型预测几何演化(Lu等人,2025年;Huang等人,2026年;Zhen等人,2025年),以及相关方法从视频生成器中构建动态高斯场景(Bahmani等人,2026年;Pan等人,2026年). 相比之下,Cosmos 3(NVIDIA,2026年)等多相机模型输出同步互动视频,但仍然缺乏共享,时间可查询的计量场景. 为了解决这个问题,我们将这些多视图的推出提升到一个统一的公制4D高斯场(图1). 我们的方法不是学习一个新的几何过渡模型,而是直接重建产生的视觉未来。

blocks.en: A naive approach would independently reconstruct each camera stream and merge the fields using camera calibration. However, post-hoc alignment fails to enforce cross-camera consistency during geometry and motion estimation, often leaving duplicated or conflicting surfaces (Figure 2 ). This issue is especially prominent in setups like DROID ( Khazatsky et al., 2024 ) , which combine fixed external and moving robot-mounted cameras where views entangle ego-motion with scene dynamics. While recent feed-forward methods enable spatio-temporal reconstruction ( Ma et al., 2025 ; Balice et al., 2026 ) , robot-camera settings specifically require joint metric estimation guided by the robot’s physical geometry and kinematics.
blocks.zh: 一种天真的方法会独立地重建每条相机流,并使用相机校准来合并场. 然而,在几何和运动估计过程中,后热调和未能强制实施交叉相机一致性,常常留下重复或冲突的表面(图2 ). 这个问题在DROID(Khazatsky等人,2024年)等设置中特别突出,它们结合了固定的外部和移动的机器人挂相机,其中的视图缠绕着自我-运动与场景动态. 虽然最近的喂食法可以进行时空重建(Ma等人,2025年;Balice等人,2026年),但机器人-相机设置特别需要以机器人物理几何学和动能学为指导进行联合计量估计。

blocks.en: We propose RoGSW4RLD, a feed-forward framework that jointly lifts synchronized robot-camera rollouts into a shared metric 4D Gaussian field. Instead of relying on post-hoc alignment, our key insight is to integrate robot-specific spatial and motion priors directly during field formation. Using joint states, hand–eye calibration, articulated meshes, and forward kinematics (FK), we ground the geometry and motion estimation within a common robot frame, while inferring object and scene dynamics solely from the visual rollout.
blocks.zh: 我们提出RoGSW4RLD,一个向导的框架,将同步的机器人-相机推出到一个共享的4D高斯场. 我们的关键洞察力不是依靠后热调和,而是在野外形成过程中直接整合机器人特有的空间和运动前序. 使用联合状态、手眼校准、清晰的介质和前向运动力学(FK),我们将几何学和运动估计放在一个共同的机器人框架之内,而仅从视觉推展中推断出物体和场景动态。

blocks.en: Our method operates in two feed-forward stages without per-scene optimization. Stage 1 performs robot-aware lifting: combining multi-view evidence with articulated geometry to anchor robot surfaces at source times, while using FK to guide, rather than analytically replace, the learned deformations of all trajectories. Stage 2 applies displacement-preserving refinement to correct residual placement and appearance errors via source-view rendering feedback. By sharing position corrections across query times, this stage perfectly preserves the relative temporal displacements established in Stage 1.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法在两个向导阶段运作,不进行人均场景优化. 第1阶段进行机器人感知提升:将多视图证据与清晰的几何学结合,在源时锁定机器人表面,同时使用FK来引导而非分析取代所有轨迹的已学习的变形. 第2阶段采用移位保留改进方法,通过源视图提供反馈来纠正剩余位置和外观错误。 通过在查询时间共享位置校正,这一阶段完全保留了第一阶段确定的相对时间位移。

blocks.en: Experiments on held-out DROID episodes demonstrate that RoGSW4RLD significantly improves novel-view rendering, metric geometry, and robot-motion accuracy compared to calibrated unions of independent reconstructions. These gains persist for action-conditioned Cosmos 3 rollouts, yielding a more consistent spatial representation of predicted futures.
blocks.zh: 对被搁置的DROID事件进行的实验表明,与独立重建的校准结合相比,RoGSW4RLD大大改进了小说视角渲染,度量几何,机器人运动精度. 这些成果继续用于以行动为条件的宇宙3的推出,使预测的未来的空间表现更加一致。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: i) a novel framework for jointly lifting synchronized multi-view robot rollouts into a shared metric 4D Gaussian field; ii) a two-stage architecture featuring robot-aware lifting and displacement-preserving refinement via articulated geometry and kinematics; and iii) substantial empirical improvements in metric geometry, novel-view synthesis, and motion accuracy on both recorded and generated robotic rollouts.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三个方面:(一) 将同步多视图机器人推出到一个共享的四维高斯领域的新框架;(二) 通过清晰的几何学和动能学改进机器人意识升降和移位保存的两阶段结构;(三) 在测量几何学、新视角合成以及记录和生成的机器人推出运动精度方面进行实质性的经验改进。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Video and Spatial World Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 视频和空间世界模式

blocks.en: Video prediction has evolved from action-conditioned dynamics for control ( Finn et al., 2016 ; Ebert et al., 2018 ) to comprehensive video-based planning and simulation ( Du et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024a ) . Recent models like Cosmos 3 ( NVIDIA, 2026 ) and Ctrl-World ( Guo et al., 2026 ) generate controllable robot rollouts, while TesserAct ( Zhen et al., 2025 ) predicts RGB alongside depth and normals. Other approaches focus on improving cross-view consistency ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) or utilize rendered robot motion as a visual condition ( Kim et al., 2026 ; Gu et al., 2026 ) . Instead of modifying the video generation process itself, RoGSW4RLD focuses on lifting the synchronized rollouts of a frozen world model into a shared metric scene.
blocks.zh: 视频预测已经从动作有条件的控制动态(Finn等人,2016年;Ebert等人,2018年)演变为综合视频规划和模拟(Du等人,2023年;Yang等人,2024年a). 近代模型如宇宙3号(NVIDIA,2026年)和Ctrl-World(Guo等人,2026年)生成可控机器人推出,而Tester Act(Zhen等人,2025年)则预测RGB与深度和常态并列. 其他方法侧重于改进交叉视角的一致性(Liu等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年)或利用已成型的机器人运动作为视觉条件(Kim等人,2026年;Gu等人,2026年)。 RoGSW4RLD没有修改视频生成过程本身,而是专注于将冷冻世界模型同步推出到共享的度量场景中.

blocks.en: Spatial world models directly forecast geometric evolution. For instance, GWM ( Lu et al., 2025 ) learns action-conditioned transitions within a Gaussian latent space, and PointWorld ( Huang et al., 2026 ) predicts 3D point flows driven by robot surface motion. Rather than learning a novel geometric transition model, RoGSW4RLD leverages the supplied visual rollout as a predicted future, reconstructing its underlying geometry and motion into a unified metric 4D field.
blocks.zh: 空间世界模型直接预测几何演变. 例如,GWM(Lu 等人,2025年)在高斯潜伏空间内学习行动条件的过渡,PointWorld(Huang等人,2026年)预测由机器人表面运动驱动的3D点流. RoGSW4RLD 与其学习新型几何过渡模型,不如利用所提供的视觉推出作为预测的未来,重建其基础几何和运动,形成一个统一的度量衡4D领域.

blocks.en: 2.2 Dynamic Scene Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 2.2 动态景区重建

blocks.en: Dynamic neural and Gaussian fields typically model scene evolution via deformation or structured space-time representations ( Pumarola et al., 2021 ; Park et al., 2021 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024b ; Lei et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ) . While these methods conventionally require per-scene optimization at test time, RoGSW4RLD employs a feed-forward approach, performing joint lifting and recurrent refinement using fixed network weights.
blocks.zh: 动态神经场和高斯场一般通过变形或结构化的时空表现进行模型场景演化(Pumarola等人,2021年;Park等人,2021年;Wu等人,2024年;Yang等人,2024年b;Lei等人,2025年b;Wang等人,2025年b). 虽然这些方法通常要求在试验时对每个场景进行优化,但RoGSW4RLD采用向导法,利用固定的网络重量进行联合提升和经常性改进。

blocks.en: Feed-forward techniques amortize the reconstruction cost across scenes. For monocular videos, 4DGT ( Xu et al., 2025 ) predicts temporally coherent Gaussians, and MoVieS ( Lin et al., 2026 ) estimates depth, Gaussian attributes, and query-time deformation. 4D-LRM ( Ma et al., 2025 ) extends reconstruction across varying views and times. Recent pose-free methods address monocular ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , driving ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , two-image ( Hur et al., 2026 ) , and multi-view ( Balice et al., 2026 ) setups. Building upon MoVieS, our framework integrates robot geometry and kinematics into the joint metric reconstruction of calibrated moving or fixed cameras. Furthermore, we adapt ReSplat ( Xu et al., 2026 ) by introducing a time-shared refinement mechanism that strictly preserves the per-Gaussian center displacements.
blocks.zh: 饲料前进技术 摊销重建成本跨场景。 对于单曲视频,4DGT(徐等人,2025年)预测时间一致的高斯人,MoVieS(Lin等人,2026年)估计深度,高斯人的属性,以及查询时间变形. 4D-LRM(Ma等人,2025年)将重建延伸至不同的观点和时间. 近代无姿势方法涉及单视(杨等人,2026年),驾驶(陈等人,2026年),双视(胡尔等人,2026年),多视(巴利采等人,2026年)设置. 在MoVieS的基础上,我们的框架将机器人几何学和动能学纳入校准移动或固定相机的联合计量重建. 此外,我们采用了一种时间共享的完善机制,严格地保留了每名广西人的中心流离失所现象,从而调整了ReSplate(徐等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Video generation models offer rich observations and features for reconstruction. CAT4D ( Wu et al., 2025 ) generates multi-view videos prior to optimizing dynamic Gaussians, whereas Diff4Splat ( Pan et al., 2026 ) decodes video diffusion representations directly into dynamic Gaussians. Lyra ( Bahmani et al., 2026 ) distills camera-controlled video diffusion into a feed-forward Gaussian decoder, extending this to dynamic video-to-4D generation. In contrast, we specifically target the joint metric lifting of robot-camera rollouts. We primarily rely on decoded RGB inputs, though an optional latent adapter can replace the token-input pathway for tighter integration.
blocks.zh: 视频生成模型为重建提供了丰富的观察和特色. CAT4D(Wu等人,2025年)在优化动态高斯人之前生成多视图视频,而Diff4Splate(Pan等人,2026年)则将视频传播表达直接解码为动态高斯人. Lyra(Bahmani等人,2026年)将相机控制的视频传播蒸馏成一个向前的高斯解码器,将其扩展到动态视频到4D生成. 相反,我们具体针对的是机器人-相机联合升空。 我们主要依靠解码的RGB输入,尽管一个可选的潜在适配器可以取代信使输入路径来进行更严格的整合.

on VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025a ) .
To adapt this backbone from monocular-video reconstruction to joint
multi-camera lifting, we apply LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) to the QKV and output

Source tokens are processed jointly across views and times with camera and

The depth and splatter heads predict source depth and base Gaussian

Following MoVieS, a query-time-conditioned motion head predicts 3D

We use a fixed conversion between internal length units and metres across
clips, without per-scene or camera-specific rescaling
(Appendix A.1 ).

blocks.en: 4.3 Training and Inference

blocks.en:
During Stage 1 training, we freeze the original backbone weights and optimize
the LoRA adapters, prediction heads, and FK-conditioning branch using
rendering, metric-depth, 3D-track, robot-FK, and opacity-coverage supervision.
We then freeze Stage 1 and the observation and error encoders to train the
Stage 2 recurrent updater and residual gates.
Its objective combines rendering, metric-depth, robot-position,
rendered-motion, track-preservation, and coverage losses.
Paired-right views contribute training losses but are excluded from
reconstruction tokens and recurrent feedback.
Stereo depth and 3D track references are used for supervision and evaluation,
not as inference inputs.
Stage 2 is trained with one to four refinement updates.
Further training details are given in Appendix A .

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented RoGSW4RLD, a feed-forward framework that converts synchronized robot-camera rollouts into a shared, time-queryable metric 4D Gaussian field. Rather than learning a separate geometric transition model, it directly reconstructs visual futures from existing video world models. Our core novelty lies in jointly forming this metric field across moving wrist and fixed external cameras by integrating articulated robot geometry and kinematics. This approach circumvents the cross-view inconsistencies of post-hoc alignment, substantially enhancing geometric consistency and motion accuracy. Additionally, our displacement-preserving refinement boosts visual quality without altering the estimated temporal dynamics.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了RoGSW4RLD,这是一个向导的框架,它将同步的机器人-相机的推出转换成一个共享的,可定时的4D高斯场. 它不是学习单独的几何过渡模型,而是直接从现有的视频世界模型中重建视觉未来. 我们的核心新颖之处在于,通过整合清晰的机器人几何学和动能学,在移动的手腕和固定的外部相机上共同形成这个测量场. 这种方法避免了后色调的交叉视野不一致,大大提高了几何一致性和运动精度. 此外,我们保存流离失所状况的改进提高了视觉质量,同时又没有改变估计的时间动态。

blocks.en: Evaluations on recorded DROID observations and action-conditioned Cosmos 3 rollouts validate these advantages across novel-view synthesis, metric geometry, and displacement accuracy. These results show that predicted multi-camera videos can be converted into coherent, queryable metric scenes without per-scene optimization or retraining the underlying world model. Ultimately, RoGSW4RLD bridges video predictions and explicit spatial representations to facilitate downstream robotic reasoning. Future work will extend this framework beyond calibrated setups to unconstrained sensing, longer horizons, and diverse robotic configurations.
blocks.zh: 对所记录的DROID观测结果和以行动为条件的Cosmos 3推出的评价验证了新颖视角综合、度量几何和迁移准确性方面的这些优势。 这些结果显示,预测的多镜头视频可以转换成连贯的,可查询的度量场景,而无需对基本的世界模型进行每个场景的优化或再培训. 归根结底,RoGSW4RLD将视频预测和清晰的空间表达方式连接起来,以便于下游机器人推理. 今后的工作将扩大这一框架的范围,使其超越经过校准的布局,扩大到不受限制的感知、更长的视野和多种多样的机器人配置。

Cosmos 3 scores compare reconstructions of generated observations against
recorded futures, combining generation and reconstruction errors.
Supplied robot trajectories remain unchanged between recorded and rollout
settings, so stable robot EPE does not demonstrate accurate visual
motion generation.

blocks.en:
Reconstruction is also sensitive to the spatial detail available in its
visual inputs.
The 16-clip Stage 1 spatial-resolution diagnostic in Appendix E.3 shows
that downsampling RGB inputs and resizing them back to the original
resolution degrades rendering and depth accuracy.
This supports sensitivity to input detail, but does not isolate rollout
resolution as the cause of the performance gap between recorded and
generated inputs.
Because RoGSW4RLD reconstructs pretrained world-model outputs rather than
learning a new transition model, it may benefit from future improvements
in the resolution and consistency of action-conditioned rollouts.

These experiments evaluate reconstruction, not physical reasoning,
task success, or closed-loop robot control.
